state.phase: string — lifecycle phase, derived from the chest counters (idle | opening). 'opening' means a chest was bought and not yet opened
state.economy.incomePerTick: number — coins minted per income tick
state.economy.canBuyChest: boolean — whether a chest is affordable
state.economy.prestige: number — cumulative prestige points banked across resets
state.economy.prestigeCount: number — resets performed; each raises the level cap
state.economy.maxLevel: number — level cap for cards drawn in the current run (MAX_LEVEL_BASE + MAX_LEVEL_PER_PRESTIGE * prestigeCount)
state.economy.prestigeGain: number — prestige points the current run would grant
state.economy.goldChestCost: number — price of a gold chest
state.economy.goldChestUnlocked: boolean — whether prestige has unlocked the gold chest
state.economy.canBuyGoldChest: boolean — whether a gold chest is unlocked and affordable
state.lastResult: object|null — the most recent chest draw {name, rarity, isNew, levelAfter, incomePerTick, coinsAwarded}
state.collection: array — owned cards sorted by rarity then level, each {name, rarity, level, copies, incomePerTick, maxLevel}

events: onChange(listener) — subscribes to every event below; returns an unsubscribe function. The listener is called as (game, event, detail) where `event` is one of the GAME_EVENT values and `detail` is event-specific
chest_bought — a chest was purchased (detail: null)
chest_opened — a chest was opened and a card drawn (detail: the ChestResult)
income_minted — passive income was banked (detail: coins minted this step)
prestige — the run was reset (detail: prestige points granted)
commands: buyChest — deduct chestCost coins and add one chest; returns boolean success
buyGoldChest — deduct goldChestCost coins and add a gold chest; returns boolean success
openChest — roll a rarity and card from the unlocked pool; returns ChestResult|null
openGoldChest — roll from a rare-or-better pool; returns ChestResult|null
prestige — reset the run, bank prestige points; returns points granted
update(deltaSeconds) — advance the economy and mint income; returns coins minted
getState — read the full observable state
